description: Optional Claude Code hooks for llm-wiki-kit. On session start, if the current repo is an LLM Wiki, print the last 3 log entries so the agent resumes with context. Deterministic; no LLM calls. Cursor and Codex have their own hook formats; see docs/solution-draft.md section 7.

hooks.command: python -c "import os,subprocess,sys; p='.llm-wiki/scripts/wiki_tools.py'; sys.exit(0) if not os.path.exists(p) else subprocess.call([sys.executable,p,'log-tail','-n','3'])"
